newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS PROFESSIONAL SYSTEMS BACK IN PROFIT IN Q2.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS PROFESSIONAL SYSTEMS BACK IN PROFIT IN Q2.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday its Professional Products and Systems division moved back into profit in the second quarter of 1997.

The division made a first-half 1997 operating profit of 95 million guilders versus a loss of 81 million in the same period of 1996. In the first quarter of this year it made a loss of 54 million guilders.
The division is made up of three main units -- Medical Systems, Business Electronics and Industrial Electronics.
Philips said Business Electronics had achieved strong sales growth in virtually all of its operations and had become profitable in the second quarter.
